body:
standingPrefixes (src/federation/channel.ts (~558-567 on main; anchor by function name)) derives a channel's prefix by cutting
the pool name at the FIRST colon after "channel:". A pool is channel:<into>:<prefix>, and a
container name may contain colons (only NUL and empty are refused), so into "ada:feed" +
prefix "alice" derives prefix "feed:alice". Verifier-confirmed failing pairs (2026-08-21):
1. MISSED REAL COLLISION (order-dependent): open into "ada:feed" prefix "alice", then open
   into "inbox" prefix "alice" — the guard compares legalNameFor("feed:alice")="feed_alice"
   against "alice", no refusal, two channels share the living-name prefix alice_* and
   channelNameOf resolves by prefix alone with .find().
2. PHANTOM REFUSAL with a false message: prefix "feed:alice" into "other" is refused claiming
   channel:ada:feed:alice assigned it — that channel's prefix is "alice".

Fix: read standing prefixes from the STAMPED channel records (channelStatusImpl already
resolves the true prefix from the record's own role pointer) instead of re-deriving by string
split. The guard's doc promise — "the receiver's own store knows every prefix it has already
assigned" — becomes true for every receiver.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) The missed-collision pair above refuses at the second open, naming the real prefix and
    its channel. Verify: new test test/federation/prefix-collision.test.ts (the existing
    federation files are frozen).
(b) The phantom pair opens successfully (two-sided). Verify: same file.
(c) A store with no channels and a store with one plain channel behave unchanged. Verify:
    same file.

Merge tier: repair — the guard delivers its documented promise. Self-merge on the ordinary bar.
title: standingPrefixes splits the pool name at the first colon — the collision guard misses and phantom-refuses
